answer: New identities arrive through the trust vine: an established sponsor locks 200 credits per admission, forfeiting half if the newcomer fakes work. Idle standing decays 5% per epoch, so every puppet must keep producing real output — an opal accrues value only through slow accumulation, never from a dead hoard. Minting 1,000 sybils locks 1,000 x 200 credits plus upkeep rising linearly per fake, while an honest agent pays once. Sponsors back only people they trust, keeping the horizon of cheap mass entry out of attackers' reach.
